# Recorded clys conditions

Each match uses held-out seeds **7001–7050**, each played in both seats: 100 games, 50 independent seed pairs. The user specified these seeds as unused. Seat piece streams use seed and seed XOR `0x9e3779b97f4a7c15`; both bots play both streams. Five previews plus active piece, hold enabled, 7-bag and SRS. Guideline attack profile: single/double/triple/Tetris **0/1/2/4**, T-spin single/double/triple **2/4/6**, mini single/double **0/1**, difficult B2B **+1**, **no combo or perfect-clear attack**. Garbage cancels against attack; all remaining incoming is inserted after each lock, with holes changing in eight-row blocks. Both sides decide before this turn’s outgoing attack is delivered. The 40-row referee uses lockout above the visible 20 rows.

Paired turns have a minimum duration of 200 ms (`--pps 5`), with a 1000-turn cap. This is turn-based pacing, not a realtime timeout. Opponent gets a **100 ms wall-clock search window per move**, suspended during Attax computation and pacing; search finalization/protocol overhead can overrun it. Attax completes fixed work without a deadline, as in the previous match. Three lanes run on distinct dedicated CPU cores 0, 1, 2; core 3 is reserved for monitoring. Both bots and referee inherit the lane affinity; only one bot thinks at a time within a lane. The preliminary unpinned seeds 7001–7002 are archived under runs/discarded-unpinned and excluded; all counted games restart under the pinned arrangement. TBP gives neither bot pending-garbage information.

Attax: default `createBot()` fighter, **beam 48**, active plus **5 previews**, default weights, no pondering. Checkout HEAD is `c4c2435`; `git diff 4b2c724 -- src/ai src/core` is empty, so the relevant source is the requested version. It sees only bottom 20 rows and ignores bag state; opponents see all 40 and can speculate from bag state. Above-row-20 incidence is reported below.

clys: commit **`ccae45fc3e30c3d3432af2b06d5b4f7f2e8dfbcc`**, TBP v1.5, shipped **`clys/config.json`** unchanged, SHA256 `198c6f1dd411b7047a26f65463a408cbd26337f32c0a23aa39aa764aefe48637`. Monte Carlo beam search defaults **width 500, depth 32, branch 3**, one search thread. Wrapper changes working directory so this exact config loads. Linux build excludes stale unused `core/piece.cpp` and defines `_countof`; frontend returns an empty suggestion instead of exiting when no plan exists. No search/evaluation tuning. Exact weights remain in `clys/config.json`.
